인덱스 범위 스캔과 리프 연결: Index range scans and leaf links
ship_date에 인덱스가 있는데, 미발송 건 조회는 테이블 전체를 읽: There is an index on ship_date, yet the unshipped-orders query reads the whole table
물류팀의 \"아직 발송 안 된 배송\" 화면이 느립니다. SQL은 <co: The logistics team's "not yet shipped" screen is slow. The SQL is where ship_date is null, and of 3.2 million rows only 1,250 have an empty ship date. The ship_date column has an index, IX_DLOG_SHIP, and statistics were gathered fresh yesterday.
적은 행을 고르고, 인덱스도 있고, 통계도 최신입니다. 그런데 실행 계획: Few rows are selected, there is an index, and the statistics are current. Yet the plan is TABLE ACCESS FULL. The answer lies in what is actually stored inside the index.
\"옵티마이저와 실행계획\"의 사례는 통계가 틀린 경우였습니다. 이번에는: The case in "The optimizer and execution plans" had wrong statistics. This time the statistics and SQL are right, but the index is structurally unable to answer the question.
B-tree의 세 층: 루트, 브랜치, 리프: The three layers of a B-tree: root, branch, leaf
Concepts에 따르면 B-tree 인덱스는 두 종류의 블록으로 이루어: According to Concepts, a B-tree index has two kinds of blocks. The branch blocks at the top are for searching (the topmost is the root), and the leaf blocks at the bottom store the actual key values.
브랜치 블록에는 \"어느 범위의 키는 어느 아래 블록에 있다\"는 정보가: Branch blocks say "keys in this range are in that lower block". As in the documentation figure, the root covers 0–40 and branches below it cover ranges like 0–10 and 11–19, so a search picks the right side at each level on the way down.
책 뒤의 찾아보기를 떠올리세요. \"ㄱ~ㄹ은 300쪽부터\" 같은 안내가: Think of the index at the back of a book: a guide like "A–D start on page 300" is a branch, and the actual list of words and page numbers is a leaf.
균형 트리: 어느 리프든 같은 깊이, 높이만큼 읽으면 도착: A balanced tree: every leaf at the same depth, reached in "height" reads
문서에 따르면 B-tree는 균형이 잡혀 있어 모든 리프 블록이 같은 깊: According to the documentation, a B-tree is balanced, so all leaf blocks are at the same depth. Finding any value reads the same number of blocks from root to leaf, which the documentation describes as finding a value in n I/Os, where n is the height.
높이는 루트부터 리프까지의 블록 수이고, 통계의 <code>BLEVEL<: Height is the number of blocks from root to leaf, and BLEVEL in the statistics is the number of branch levels, height − 1. BLEVEL 2 on the previous screen means height 3: root → branch → leaf, three blocks. Even with millions of rows, the height usually stays at a few levels.
320만 행 가운데 하나를 찾는 데 인덱스 블록 3개와 테이블 블록 1개: Finding one row out of 3.2 million takes 3 index blocks plus 1 table block. A full table scan would be tens of thousands of blocks.
리프 블록: 정렬된 키와, 그 행이 있는 곳(rowid): Leaf blocks: sorted keys and where each row lives (the rowid)
리프 블록에는 인덱스 키 값과 그 행의 <span class=\"term: Leaf blocks hold pairs of an index key value and that row's rowid. According to the SQL Tuning Guide, a rowid is a 10-byte physical address that specifies which block of which data file holds the row. With the key and rowid, the table row is found directly.
리프의 키는 기본으로 오름차순 정렬되어 있습니다. 같은 키 값이 여러 행: Keys in leaves are sorted in ascending order by default. If the same key value appears in several rows (a nonunique index), the same key has several rowids. If customer 73 has 40 deliveries, key 73 has 40 rowids in a row.
<code>select rowid from 테이블</code>로 rowi: You can see rowids directly with select rowid from table. This value is how an index points to a table row.
인덱스 고유 스캔: 한 번 내려가 rowid 하나: Index unique scan: one descent, one rowid
기본 키와 고유 키에는 인덱스가 자동으로 만들어집니다. 고유 인덱스의 모: Indexes are created automatically for primary and unique keys. An equality condition on all columns of a unique index returns at most one row, so the optimizer uses an index unique scan (INDEX UNIQUE SCAN). The documentation says a unique scan returns at most one rowid.
The blocks read are as many as the height (root, branch, leaf) plus one table block. That is why the screen that looks up one delivery by number is always fast.
DBA 실습 레슨 71에서 실행 계획의 Operation 열을 읽었습니다: In DBA lab 71 you read the Operation column of a plan. INDEX UNIQUE SCAN followed by TABLE ACCESS BY INDEX ROWID is exactly this scene.
인덱스 범위 스캔: 한 번 내려간 뒤 리프를 따라 옆으로: Index range scan: descend once, then walk sideways along the leaves
리프 블록들은 앞뒤로 서로 연결되어 있습니다(이중 연결 리스트). <sp: Leaf blocks are linked to each other forwards and backwards (a doubly linked list). An index range scan descends once to the leaf holding the first key of the range, then follows the links sideways to the next leaves, reading in key order. In the documentation's words, a range scan proceeds horizontally through the linked list of leaf nodes.
리프에서 찾은 rowid마다 테이블 블록을 읽습니다(TABLE ACCES: For each rowid found in the leaves, the table block is read (TABLE ACCESS BY INDEX ROWID). A key can have several rowids, so an equality condition on a nonunique index (cust_id = 73) is also a range scan. And because the scan reads in key order, a range scan can sometimes avoid a separate sort when sorted results are needed.
DBA 실습 레슨 72에서 날짜 범위 조건으로 바꾸자 INDEX RANG: In DBA lab 72, changing to a date range condition gave INDEX RANGE SCAN: it descended to the leaf holding the November 1 key and read sideways up to just before December 1.
클러스터링 팩터: 인덱스 순서와 테이블 순서가 얼마나 닮았나: Clustering factor: how closely table order follows index order
범위 스캔은 rowid마다 테이블 블록을 읽습니다. 같은 범위의 키가 같: A range scan reads a table block for each rowid. If keys in the same range sit in the same table blocks, a few blocks suffice; if they are scattered, each rowid means a different block. The value that measures this is the clustering factor.
Concepts에 따르면 테이블 행의 순서가 인덱스 순서를 잘 따를수록: According to Concepts, the more closely table rows follow index order, the lower the clustering factor. When it is low, keys in a range point to the same blocks, and the value matters in deciding whether an index is used for large range scans.
배송 기록은 시간 순서로 쌓이므로 dlv_id(일련번호) 인덱스는 테이블: Delivery records pile up in time order, so the dlv_id (sequence number) index resembles table order, while the cust_id index does not, since customers are scattered. The same 1,000 rows can mean very different numbers of table blocks.
인덱스는 공짜가 아니다: DML마다 함께 고쳐진다: Indexes are not free: they are updated with every DML
Concepts에 따르면 인덱스는 테이블 데이터가 바뀌면 자동으로 함께: According to Concepts, indexes change automatically when table data changes. One INSERT must find the right leaf in every index and put a key there. The documentation explains that many indexes degrade DML performance.
복합 인덱스(여러 열)는 앞쪽 열부터 정렬되므로, 조건에 앞쪽 열이 있어: A composite (multicolumn) index is sorted by its leading column first, so it works best when the condition includes the leading column. Without the leading column it can only be used by a skip scan, when the leading column has few distinct values. That is why you check for an existing index starting with the same columns before creating a new one.
DBA 실습 레슨 73에서 업무 시간에 인덱스를 ONLINE으로 만든 이: This is also why DBA lab 73 created the index ONLINE during business hours. Both building an index and every insert afterwards have a cost.
~ 인덱스마다 리프 찾아 키 넣기: ~ find a leaf and add a key in each index
사례: 단일 열 B-tree 인덱스에는 NULL이 없다: Case: a single-column B-tree index holds no NULLs
1장면의 원인입니다. Concepts에 따르면 단일 열 B-tree 인덱: This is the cause from scene 1. According to Concepts, a single-column B-tree index does not store NULLs, and rows whose indexed columns are all NULL are not indexed. The 1,250 unshipped rows have a NULL ship_date, so they are not in IX_DLOG_SHIP at all. That is why this index had 1,250 fewer rows than the table on the earlier screen.
인덱스에 없는 행은 인덱스로 찾을 수 없으니, 옵티마이저는 전체 스캔을: Rows not in the index cannot be found through it, so the optimizer has no choice but a full scan. The fix that follows from this statement is to make sure the indexed columns are never "all NULL". A composite index (ship_date, dlv_id) with the NOT NULL column dlv_id appended puts every row in the index. It is business hours, so build it ONLINE and recheck the plan.
이 해결 방법은 문서의 NULL 규칙에서 이끌어 낸 것입니다. 운영에 적: This fix is derived from the NULL rule in the documentation. Before applying it in production, always check the execution plan with the same data, and also weigh the DML cost of a new index (scene 8) and whether to retire the existing IX_DLOG_SHIP.
× NULL 1,250행: 인덱스에 없음: × 1,250 NULL rows: not in the index
정리: 위에서 내려가고, 옆으로 읽고, rowid로 건너간다: Recap: descend from the top, read sideways, jump by rowid
B-tree 인덱스는 브랜치 블록(루트 포함)과 리프 블록으로 이루어진: A B-tree index is a balanced tree of branch blocks (including the root) and leaf blocks. Any key is reached by reading as many blocks as the height, and leaves hold sorted keys and rowids. A unique scan returns one rowid; a range scan reads sideways along the linked leaves.
범위 스캔의 테이블 읽기는 클러스터링 팩터에 따라 달라지고, 인덱스는 D: Table reads in a range scan depend on the clustering factor, and indexes cost something on every DML. And a single-column index holds no NULLs, which is another common reason for "there is an index but it is not used".
